Native cost_usd is Harbor pricing-derived evidence, not a provider invoice; pinned code falls back to per-call LiteLLM pricing including cache read/write. The separate conservative estimate charges all input including cached input at $20/M and output at $30/M. Historical cumulative spending remains unknown.
